```{r}
coralSDM.Ahya <- terra::rast("data/maxent_predrast_GBR_AhyaD_015_lq2.tif")
coralSDM.Aspat <- terra::rast("data/maxent_predrast_GBR_Aspat_015_lq2.tif")

#John Brewer

# Britomart
# bb_wgs <- ext(145.65, 145.88, -16.48, -16.33)
# 2) Turn extent -> polygon with CRS, then project to raster CRS (MGA55)

bb_mga_poly <- project(bb_wgs_poly, crs(coralSDM.Ahya))


coralSDM.Ahya_crop <- crop(coralSDM.Ahya, bb_mga_poly)
coralSDM.Aspat_crop <- crop(coralSDM.Aspat, bb_mga_poly)
coralSDM.Aten_crop <- crop(coralSDM.Aten, bb_mga_poly)

plot(coralSDM.Ahya_crop)
plot(coralSDM.Aspat_crop)
plot(coralSDM.Aten_crop)
```

## Create Template Grid

```{r Create Template Grid}
template30 <- env30[[1]]
res(template30)   # should be ~30 m
ext(template30)
crs(template30)   # should now be EPSG:7855

# Align resolution/extent to the 30 m template
Ahya_30  <- resample(coralSDM.Ahya,  template30, method = "bilinear")
Aspat_30 <- resample(coralSDM.Aspat, template30, method = "bilinear")
Aten_30  <- resample(coralSDM.Aten,  template30, method = "bilinear")


all.equal(crs(Ahya_30),  crs(template30))
all.equal(crs(Aspat_30), crs(template30))
all.equal(crs(Aten_30),  crs(template30))
res(Ahya_30); res(template30)

# keep env layers separate if you like
names(env30)  # rename if needed to sensible names

coral_sdm_30 <- c(Ahya_30, Aspat_30, Aten_30)
names(coral_sdm_30) <- c("SDM_Ahya", "SDM_Aspat", "SDM_Aten")

predictors_terra <- c(env30, coral_sdm_30)
predictors_terra

library(raster)

predictors_raster <- raster::stack(c(env30, coral_sdm_30))
predictors_raster


pred_stack_file <- "data/predictors_terra_30m.tif"
writeRaster(
    predictors_terra,
    filename = pred_stack_file,
    overwrite = TRUE,
    gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW")  # smaller file, ArcGIS-friendly
  )
message("Saved predictor stack to: ", pred_stack_file)
```

## ReefGuideData

```{r}
library(terra)

pred_stack_file <- "data/predictors_terra_30m.tif"

if (file.exists(pred_stack_file)) {

  message("Loading existing predictor stack: ", pred_stack_file)

  # Read saved SpatRaster
  predictors_terra  <- rast(pred_stack_file)

  # If you still want a RasterStack version
  predictors_raster <- raster::stack(predictors_terra)

} else {
  message("No saved predictor stack found – build from scratch...")
}

## ---- reefguide_mosaic_30m ----------------------------------------------


## ---- reefguide_merge_30m ----------------------------------------------
library(terra)

rg_dir <- "data/GBR-ReefGuidance-processed_2025-11-19"

# Variables we want from ReefGuide
rg_vars <- c(
  "bathy",
  "hybrid_benthic",
  "hybrid_geomorphic",
  "high_tide",
  "low_tide",
  "slope",
  "turbid",
  "waves_Hs",
  "waves_Tp"
)

# Treat these as categorical (nearest neighbour resampling)
rg_cat <- c("hybrid_benthic", "hybrid_geomorphic")

rg_layers <- list()

for (v in rg_vars) {
  message("Processing ReefGuide variable: ", v)

  files_v <- list.files(
    rg_dir,
    pattern     = paste0(v, "\\.tif$"),
    full.names  = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  if (length(files_v) == 0) {
    warning("No files found for ReefGuide variable: ", v)
    next
  }

  method <- if (v %in% rg_cat) "near" else "bilinear"

  # 1) Project each regional tile directly onto the 30 m template grid
  proj_tiles <- vector("list", length(files_v))

  for (i in seq_along(files_v)) {
    f <- files_v[i]
    r <- rast(f)

    out_i <- file.path(tempdir(), paste0("RG_", v, "_tile", i, "_30m.tif"))

    proj_tiles[[i]] <- project(
      r,
      y         = template30,
      method    = method,
      filename  = out_i,
      overwrite = TRUE
    )
  }

  # 2) Merge projected tiles (now same CRS/resolution/alignment)
  r_30 <- do.call(merge, proj_tiles)

  names(r_30) <- paste0("RG_", v)

  rg_layers[[v]] <- r_30

  rm(proj_tiles, r_30)
  gc()
}


rg_mosaics <- rg_layers
# Inspect what you actually have
str(rg_mosaics, max.level = 1)

# Keep only elements that are actual SpatRasters
rg_mosaics_ok <- rg_mosaics[
  vapply(rg_mosaics, inherits, logical(1), "SpatRaster")
]

if (length(rg_mosaics_ok) == 0) {
  stop("No valid ReefGuide rasters in rg_mosaics")
}

# Start with the first SpatRaster
reefguide_30 <- rg_mosaics_ok[[1]]

# Iteratively add the rest using terra's c.SpatRaster method
if (length(rg_mosaics_ok) > 1) {
  for (i in 2:length(rg_mosaics_ok)) {
    reefguide_30 <- c(reefguide_30, rg_mosaics_ok[[i]])
  }
}

class(reefguide_30)
nlyr(reefguide_30)
names(reefguide_30)



# existing env + coral SDMs
predictors_terra <- c(env30, coral_sdm_30, reefguide_30)
predictors_terra

library(raster)
predictors_raster <- raster::stack(predictors_terra)
predictors_raster


pred_stack_file <- "data/predictors_terra_30m.tif"
writeRaster(
    predictors_terra,
    filename = pred_stack_file,
    overwrite = TRUE,
    gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW")  # smaller file, ArcGIS-friendly
  )
message("Saved predictor stack to: ", pred_stack_file)
```

##Mask Rasters to GBR Features

```{r}
############################################################
# Mask full predictor stack to reef polygons
# - GeoPackage: "data/Great_Barrier_Reef_Features.gpkg"
# - Reef polygons are in EPSG:7844 (GDA2020 geographic)
# - Rasters are also in EPSG:7844 (NOT 7855 as first told)
############################################################

library(terra)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyterra)

## 1. Read reef polygons -----------------------------------

# Option 1: if there's only one layer in the GeoPackage
reef_poly <- terra::vect("data/Great_Barrier_Reef_Features.gpkg") |>
  filter(FEAT_NAME=="Reef")
attr_reefs <- as.data.frame(reef_poly)

# Option 2: if there are multiple layers and you know the layer name:
# reef_poly <- terra::vect("data/Great_Barrier_Reef_Features.gpkg",
#                          layer = "Great_Barrier_Reef_Features")

# Inspect CRS of polygons
crs(reef_poly)



# Should show something like: "EPSG:7844"

## 2. Check CRS of rasters ---------------------------------

# If the CRSs differ, reproject reef_poly to the raster CRS:
if (crs(reef_poly) != crs(predictors_terra)) {
  message("Reprojecting reef polygons to raster CRS...")
  reef_poly <- terra::project(reef_poly, crs(predictors_terra))
}

cat("\nRaster extent:\n")
print(ext(predictors_terra))
cat("\nReef extent:\n")
print(ext(reef_poly))

cat("\nIs raster lon/lat? ", is.lonlat(predictors_terra), "\n")
cat("Is reef lon/lat?   ", is.lonlat(reef_poly), "\n")

## 3. Crop + mask the whole SpatRaster ---------------------
plot(predictors_terra[[21]], main = "Predictor unmasked")
# # First crop to the reef polygon extent – faster than masking full GBR
predictors_reef_crop <- terra::crop(predictors_terra, reef_poly)
plot(predictors_terra[[21]], main = "Predictor cropped")
# Then apply mask: cells OUTSIDE reef polygons become NA
predictors_reef <- terra::mask(predictors_terra, reef_poly)

# Quick visual check of one layer
plot(predictors_reef[[1]], main = "Predictor masked to reef areas")
plot(predictors_reef[[21]], main = "Predictor masked to reef areas")


# Check it’s sane once before saving
predictors_reef
names(predictors_reef)

# predictors_reef <- c(predictors_reef, benthic_rast, geomorph_rast)

# Save to disk as a multi-band GeoTIFF
writeRaster(
  predictors_reef,
  filename = "data/predictors_reef.tif",
  overwrite = TRUE,
  gdal = c("COMPRESS=LZW")  # optional compression
)
```

```{r Load survey data}
dat.cull <- read_excel("data/250929_COTS-Manta-Cull-RHIS-Data-Matthews-and-Schlawinsky.xlsx", sheet = 4) |>
  mutate(VoyageTitle = as.factor(VoyageTitle),
         YearQr = zoo::as.yearqtr(SurveyDate),
         Year = lubridate::year(SurveyDate),
         Total = Cohort1 +Cohort2+Cohort3+Cohort4,
         CPUE = Total/Bottomtime) %>%
  group_by(ReefName, CullSiteName, Year, Latitude, Longitude) %>%
  summarise(MaxCPUE = max(CPUE),
            CPUE = sum(Total, na.rm = T)/sum(Bottomtime, na.rm = T),
            Total = sum(Total),
            Bottomtime = sum(Bottomtime)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Longitude))

dat.cull_sf <- dat.cull |>
  st_as_sf(
    coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),  # <- CHANGE if your cols are named differently
    crs    = 4326              # WGS84 geographic
  )

plot(dat.cull_sf)

# Your predictor rasters are in EPSG:7844 (GDA2020 geographic),
# so we transform the survey points to that CRS:
survey_sf <- dat.cull_sf |> st_transform(7844)

```

```{r}
############################################################
# COTS SDM with XGBoost
# - Model 1: "Problematic" COTS presence (classification)
# - Model 2: COTS density per ha (regression)
# - Includes raster predictors + reef/sector outbreak covariates
# - Uses spatially blocked cross-validation (blockCV)
############################################################

## 0. Packages ------------------------------------------------------------

library(terra)        # raster predictors
library(sf)           # spatial survey data
library(dplyr)        # data wrangling
library(tidyr)
library(tidymodels)   # modelling framework
library(blockCV)      # spatial CV
library(ggplot2)      # plotting (optional)
library(xgboost)      # xgboost engine for parsnip

tidymodels::tidymodels_prefer()

## 1. Inputs & assumptions -----------------------------------------------
# You need to have these objects already created / loaded:

# 1) predictors_terra: SpatRaster with all environmental predictors
#    (bathymetry, rugosity, SDMs, etc.) in EPSG:7855, aligned to your grid.
#    e.g. from earlier:
#    predictors_terra <- c(env30, coral_sdm_30)

# 2) survey_sf: sf object with one row per survey / reef-visit / tow:
#      - cots_density_ha : numeric COTS density per ha
#      - reef_id         : reef identifier (factor/character)
#      - sector          : sector ID / region (factor/character)
#      - year            : survey year (numeric or factor)
#      - geometry        : POINT (or centroid) in EPSG:7855

# 3) outbreak_pred_df (optional): data frame with reef/year-level metrics:
#      - reef_id, year
#      - e.g. cots_outbreak_prob, sector_mean_density, etc.
#
# Make sure CRS(predictors_terra) and st_crs(survey_sf) are both EPSG:7855.




## 2. Define response variables ------------------------------------------

# 2.1 Threshold for "problematic" COTS densities
#     (set according to program definitions)
problem_threshold <- 0.02  # example: 30 COTS/ha; adjust to your threshold

# Ensure density is numeric and create binary response
survey_sf <- survey_sf %>%
  mutate(
    cots_density_cpue = as.numeric(CPUE),
    # Binary target: 1 = problematic density, 0 = below threshold
    cots_problem = if_else(cots_density_cpue >= problem_threshold, 1L, 0L)
  )


## 3. Extract raster predictors at survey locations ----------------------

# 3.1 Ensure CRSs match (project survey_sf to raster CRS if needed)
survey_sf <- st_transform(survey_sf, crs(predictors_reef))


# 3.2 Add explicit ID for safe joining
survey_sf$ID <- seq_len(nrow(survey_sf))

# 3.3 Extract raster values
pred_vals <- terra::extract(predictors_reef, vect(survey_sf))

#Need to add to take predictors that are within ~20m

#####IM HERE#####


# 'pred_vals' has column 'ID' from the vect() input
# Join raster predictors back to survey attributes (without geometry)
coords <- st_coordinates(dat.cull_sf)

survey_df <- survey_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    x = coords[, 1],
    y = coords[, 2]
  ) %>%
  left_join(pred_vals, by = "ID")

# 3.4 Add outbreak / sector-level predictors (if available)
#     outbreak_pred_df: one row per reef_id & year with extra covariates
# THis owens outbreaks model to be included later
if (exists("outbreak_pred_df")) {
  survey_df <- survey_df %>%
    left_join(outbreak_pred_df, by = c("reef_id", "year"))
}

# 3.5 Drop ID (no longer needed)
survey_df <- survey_df %>% dplyr::select(-ID)

# Quick check
glimpse(survey_df)


## 4. Spatial blocking for cross-validation -------------------------------

# 4.1 Use the sf object (with geometry) for blockCV
#     We only need the cots_problem response + geometry here.
survey_for_blocks <- survey_sf %>%
  dplyr::select(cots_problem)

# 4.2 Define spatial blocks
#     - theRange: spatial block size in metres; adjust sensibly (e.g. 50–100 km)
set.seed(123)
sb <- spatialBlock(
  speciesData = survey_for_blocks,
  species     = "cots_problem",
  theRange    = 50000,    # ~50 km blocks (example)
  k           = 5,        # 5-fold CV
  selection   = "random",
  showBlocks  = FALSE
)

# blockCV returns foldID vector (one per observation)
survey_df$fold_id <- sb$foldID

# You can reuse these fold IDs for both classification & regression models.


## 5. Prepare modelling data frames --------------------------------------

# 5.1 Identify predictor column names from raster stack
pred_cols <- names(predictors_reef)[c(1:12, 19)]

# 5.2 Identify outbreak covariates (if present)
outbreak_cols <- character(0)
if (exists("outbreak_pred_df")) {
  outbreak_cols <- setdiff(names(outbreak_pred_df), c("reef_id", "year"))
}

# survey_sf_utm <- st_transform(survey_sf, crs(predictors_reef))
#
# xy <- st_coordinates(survey_sf_utm)
#
# survey_df <- survey_df %>%
#   mutate(
#     x = xy[,1],
#     y = xy[,2]
#   )

# 5.3 Build base modelling data frame
model_df <- survey_df %>%
  dplyr::select(
    cots_problem,          # classification target
    cots_density_cpue,       # regression target
    ReefName,
    # sector,
    Year,
    fold_id,
    # x,y,
    dplyr::all_of(pred_cols),
    dplyr::all_of(outbreak_cols)
  )  # drop categorical predictors for now)

# 5.4 Remove rows with missing response or predictors
model_df <- model_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(cots_problem), !is.na(cots_density_cpue)) %>%
  drop_na(dplyr::all_of(pred_cols))

# Optional: drop rows with rare / unused factor levels
model_df <- model_df %>%
  mutate(
    cots_problem = as.factor(cots_problem),
    ReefName = as.factor(ReefName),
    # sector  = as.factor(sector),
    # Year    = as.factor(Year)
  ) %>% ungroup() %>%
  #need to check how to add factors
  dplyr::select(-ReefName)

glimpse(model_df)



## 6. Model 1: XGBoost classification (problematic COTS) -----------------

# 6.1 CV folds based on spatial blocks
set.seed(123)
cv_folds_cls <- group_vfold_cv(model_df, group = fold_id, v = 5)

# 6.2 Recipe: preprocess predictors
rec_cls <- recipe(cots_problem ~ ., data = model_df %>% dplyr::select(-cots_density_cpue)) %>%
  # fold_id is for CV grouping only; remove as predictor
  update_role(fold_id, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_rm(fold_id) %>%
  # near-zero variance predictors
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  # normalise numeric predictors (optional but often helpful)
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

# 6.3 XGBoost model specification (tuned)
xgb_spec_cls <- boost_tree(
  trees          = 1500,
  tree_depth     = tune(),
  learn_rate     = tune(),
  loss_reduction = tune(),
  min_n          = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("xgboost") %>%
  set_mode("classification")

# 6.4 Workflow
wf_cls <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(xgb_spec_cls) %>%
  add_recipe(rec_cls)

# 6.5 Hyperparameter tuning with blocked CV
set.seed(123)
grid_cls <- grid_space_filling(
  tree_depth(),
  learn_rate(),
  loss_reduction(),
  min_n(),
  size = 30
)

res_cls <- tune_grid(
  wf_cls,
  resamples = cv_folds_cls,
  grid      = grid_cls,
  metrics   = metric_set(roc_auc, pr_auc, accuracy)
)

# 6.6 Select best hyperparameters (maximising ROC AUC)
best_cls <- select_best(res_cls, metric = "roc_auc")

# 6.7 Finalise workflow and fit on all data
final_wf_cls <- finalize_workflow(wf_cls, best_cls)

set.seed(123)
fit_cls <- final_wf_cls %>%
  fit(data = model_df)

fit_cls

# 6.8 Optional: model performance using CV results
model_metrics <- collect_metrics(res_cls)

# 6.9 Optional: variable importance plot
vip_cls <- fit_cls %>%
  extract_fit_parsnip() %>%
  vip::vip(num_features = 20)

print(vip_cls)

```

## Model Fitting multiThresholds

```{r}
############################################################
# COTS SDM (classification) – BOTH:
#   A) Year-specific models (Year included as predictor; data aggregated by Year)
#   B) Year-agnostic models (no Year predictor; data aggregated across all years)
#
# For EACH, fit 3 thresholds: 0.00, 0.02, 0.04 on CPUE
#
# Assumes you already have:
#   - predictors_reef : SpatRaster (masked / aligned predictor stack)
############################################################

## 0) Packages ------------------------------------------------------------
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(tidymodels)
library(blockCV)
library(lubridate)

tidymodels::tidymodels_prefer()

## 1) Parameters ----------------------------------------------------------
thresholds   <- c(0.00, 0.02, 0.04)
block_km     <- 50                 # spatial block size (km); converted if lon/lat
seed         <- 123
cpue_field   <- "CPUE_mean"        # choose: "CPUE_mean" or "CPUE_max"

# Choose which raster layers to include (your curated continuous set)
# (keep this as your known-good set)
predictors_reef <- terra::rast("data/predictors_reef.tif")
pred_cols <- names(predictors_reef)[c(1:12)]
pred_cols <- pred_cols[pred_cols %in% names(predictors_reef)]


## 2) Helper: compute suitable block range units --------------------------
block_range_for_sf <- function(x_sf, km = 50) {
  # blockCV::spatialBlock expects "theRange" in the units of the CRS
  # If lon/lat (degrees), approximate degrees from km.
  if (sf::st_is_longlat(x_sf)) {
    return(km / 111.32)   # ~ degrees per km
  } else {
    return(km * 1000)     # metres
  }
}


## 3) Load raw cull data --------------------------------------------------
raw_cull <- read_excel(
  "data/250929_COTS-Manta-Cull-RHIS-Data-Matthews-and-Schlawinsky.xlsx",
  sheet = 4
) %>%
  mutate(
    VoyageTitle = as.factor(VoyageTitle),
    SurveyDate  = as.Date(SurveyDate),
    Year        = lubridate::year(SurveyDate),
    Total       = Cohort1 + Cohort2 + Cohort3 + Cohort4,
    CPUE        = Total / Bottomtime
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Longitude), !is.na(Latitude),
    !is.na(Bottomtime), Bottomtime > 0
  )


## 4) Helper: prepare modelling table (year-specific or agnostic) ---------
prep_dataset <- function(mode = c("year", "agnostic"),
                         raw_df,
                         predictors_reef,
                         pred_cols,
                         cpue_field = "CPUE_mean",
                         block_km = 50,
                         seed = 123) {

  mode <- match.arg(mode)

  # ---- A) aggregate -----------------------------------------------------
  if (mode == "year") {
    dat <- raw_df %>%
      group_by(ReefName, CullSiteName, Year, Latitude, Longitude) %>%
      summarise(
        CPUE_mean  = sum(Total, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Bottomtime, na.rm = TRUE),
        CPUE_max   = max(CPUE, na.rm = TRUE),
        Total      = sum(Total, na.rm = TRUE),
        Bottomtime = sum(Bottomtime, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_surveys  = dplyr::n(),
        .groups    = "drop"
      )
  } else {
    dat <- raw_df %>%
      group_by(ReefName, CullSiteName, Latitude, Longitude) %>%
      summarise(
        CPUE_mean  = sum(Total, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(Bottomtime, na.rm = TRUE),
        CPUE_max   = max(CPUE, na.rm = TRUE),
        Total      = sum(Total, na.rm = TRUE),
        Bottomtime = sum(Bottomtime, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_surveys  = dplyr::n(),
        Year_min   = min(Year, na.rm = TRUE),
        Year_max   = max(Year, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups    = "drop"
      )
  }

  # ---- B) sf conversion + CRS match to rasters -------------------------
  survey_sf <- st_as_sf(dat, coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"), crs = 4326) %>%
    st_transform(crs(predictors_reef))

  # # add x/y in the SAME CRS as predictors_reef
  # xy <- st_coordinates(survey_sf)
  # survey_sf$x <- xy[, 1]
  # survey_sf$y <- xy[, 2]

  # ---- C) extract raster predictors ------------------------------------
  survey_sf$ID <- seq_len(nrow(survey_sf))
  pred_vals <- terra::extract(predictors_reef[[pred_cols]], terra::vect(survey_sf))

  survey_df <- survey_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    left_join(pred_vals, by = "ID") %>%
    select(-ID)

  # choose CPUE response used for thresholding
  survey_df <- survey_df %>%
    mutate(cots_density_cpue = as.numeric(.data[[cpue_field]]))

  # drop rows missing predictors/response
  keep_cols <- c("cots_density_cpue", pred_cols)
  if (mode == "year") keep_cols <- c(keep_cols, "Year")

  survey_df <- survey_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(cots_density_cpue)) %>%
    drop_na(all_of(pred_cols))

  # ---- D) spatial blocks (once per dataset) ----------------------------
  # blockCV uses the geometry in survey_sf, so subset survey_sf to matching rows
  # (match by row order after filtering)
  survey_sf2 <- survey_sf %>%
    mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
    filter(row_id %in% survey_df$row_id %||% row_id)  # fallback; see below

  # safer: rebuild row_id in both in same order
  survey_df <- survey_df %>% mutate(row_id = row_number())
  survey_sf2 <- survey_sf %>% mutate(row_id = row_number())

  # keep only those rows that survived drop_na
  survey_sf2 <- survey_sf2 %>% filter(row_id %in% survey_df$row_id)

  theRange <- block_range_for_sf(survey_sf2, km = block_km)

  set.seed(seed)
  sb <- spatialBlock(
    speciesData = survey_sf2,
    species     = NULL,
    theRange    = theRange,
    k           = 5,
    selection   = "random",
    showBlocks  = FALSE
  )

  # attach fold ids back to survey_df in the same order
  survey_df$fold_id <- sb$foldID

  # ---- E) build base modelling df --------------------------------------
  if (mode == "year") {
    base_df <- survey_df %>%
      transmute(
        cots_density_cpue,
        Year = as.numeric(Year),   # keep numeric Year predictor
        fold_id,
        # x, y,
        across(all_of(pred_cols), as.numeric)
      )
  } else {
    base_df <- survey_df %>%
      transmute(
        cots_density_cpue,
        fold_id,
        # x, y,
        across(all_of(pred_cols), as.numeric)
      )
  }

  list(
    mode      = mode,
    survey_sf = survey_sf2,
    base_df   = base_df
  )
}


## 5) Helper: fit one threshold model (XGBoost) ---------------------------
fit_threshold_model <- function(threshold, base_df, seed = 123) {

  model_df <- base_df %>%
    mutate(
      cots_problem = factor(if_else(cots_density_cpue > threshold, 1L, 0L),
                            levels = c(0, 1))
    ) %>%
    select(cots_problem, fold_id, everything(), -cots_density_cpue)
  # browser()
  set.seed(seed)
  cv_folds <- group_vfold_cv(model_df, group = fold_id, v = 5)

  # IMPORTANT: remove fold_id entirely so it is NOT required at predict-time
  rec <- recipe(cots_problem ~ ., data = model_df) %>%
    step_rm(fold_id) %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

  xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
    trees          = 1500,
    tree_depth     = tune(),
    learn_rate     = tune(),
    loss_reduction = tune(),
    min_n          = tune()
  ) %>%
    set_engine("xgboost") %>%
    set_mode("classification")

  wf <- workflow() %>%
    add_recipe(rec) %>%
    add_model(xgb_spec)

  set.seed(seed)
  grid <- grid_space_filling(
    tree_depth(),
    learn_rate(),
    loss_reduction(),
    min_n(),
    size = 15
  )

  res <- tune_grid(
    wf,
    resamples = cv_folds,
    grid      = grid,
    metrics   = metric_set(roc_auc, pr_auc, accuracy)
  )

  best <- select_best(res, metric = "roc_auc")
  final_wf <- finalize_workflow(wf, best)

  set.seed(seed)
  fit <- fit(final_wf, data = model_df)

  list(
    threshold = threshold,
    model_df  = model_df,
    res       = res,
    best      = best,
    fit       = fit
  )
}


## 6) Build BOTH datasets -------------------------------------------------
ds_year <- prep_dataset(
  mode          = "year",
  raw_df        = raw_cull,
```

```{r}
library(tidymodels)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(xgboost)

# --- helper: extract xgboost importance from a tidymodels workflow --------
get_xgb_importance <- function(fit_workflow, model_name) {
  booster <- fit_workflow %>% extract_fit_parsnip() %>% purrr::pluck("fit")
  imp <- xgboost::xgb.importance(model = booster)
  imp$model <- model_name
  imp
}

# --- collect importance for all 6 models --------------------------------
imp_all <- bind_rows(
  imap_dfr(fits_year,     ~get_xgb_importance(.x$fit, paste0("year_", .y))),
  imap_dfr(fits_agnostic, ~get_xgb_importance(.x$fit, paste0("agn_",  .y)))
)

# --- choose top N per model ---------------------------------------------
top_n <- 15

imp_top <- imp_all %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = Gain, n = top_n, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

# --- create a model-specific factor order without tidytext ---------------
# trick: make a unique key per facet, order by Gain within facet
imp_top <- imp_top %>%
  mutate(
    feat_key = paste(model, Feature, sep = "___")
  ) %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  arrange(Gain, .by_group = TRUE) %>%       # ascending so biggest ends up at top after coord_flip
  mutate(feat_key = factor(feat_key, levels = feat_key)) %>%
  ungroup()

# mapping from key -> plain Feature for axis labels
key_labs <- substr(setNames(imp_top$Feature, imp_top$feat_key),1,10)

# --- plot ---------------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(imp_top, aes(x = feat_key, y = Gain)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ model, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = key_labs) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "XGBoost Gain",
    title = paste0("Top ", top_n, " variable importances per model")
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Predict 6 fitted classification models to reef grid and
# write one multi-band GeoTIFF:
#   (year models)     thr 0.00, 0.02, 0.04
#   (agnostic models) thr 0.00, 0.02, 0.04
############################################################

library(terra)
library(tidymodels)


predictors_reef <- terra::rast("data/predictors_reef.tif")
# -------- settings -------------------------------------------------------
out_tif <- "outputs/COTS_prob_6models.tif"
dir.create(dirname(out_tif), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# choose the Year value to inject for year-specific models
# (set to 2025 or max Year in your year-training dataframe)
YEAR_TO_PREDICT <- 2025

# -------- helper: safely stack multiple SpatRasters ----------------------
stack_rasters <- function(r_list) {
  r_list <- r_list[vapply(r_list, inherits, logical(1), "SpatRaster")]
  if (length(r_list) == 0) stop("No SpatRaster objects to stack.")
  out <- r_list[[1]]
  if (length(r_list) > 1) {
    for (i in 2:length(r_list)) out <- c(out, r_list[[i]])
  }
  out
}

# -------- helper: predict one workflow to raster grid --------------------
predict_workflow_to_grid <- function(fit_obj, predictors_reef, year_value = YEAR_TO_PREDICT,
                                     layer_name = "prob") {

  # training data used for this fitted workflow
  # (from your fit_threshold_model() list: model_df includes outcome + predictors)
  train_df <- fit_obj$model_df

  # Identify which predictors are required by the *training columns*.
  # We'll provide:
  #   - raster predictors from predictors_reef
  #   - x/y as coordinate rasters if required
  #   - Year injected as constant if required
  #   - fold_id injected as constant if required (hardhat often requires it)
  needed_cols <- setdiff(names(train_df), "cots_problem")

  need_year   <- "Year" %in% needed_cols
  need_fold   <- "fold_id" %in% needed_cols
  need_xy     <- all(c("x", "y") %in% needed_cols)
  print(paste("Predicting with model needing:", paste(needed_cols, collapse = ", ")))
  # Raster predictors needed = those needed_cols that are raster layer names
  raster_needed <- base:: intersect(needed_cols, names(predictors_reef))

  if (length(raster_needed) == 0) {
    stop("No raster predictors found for this model. Check names(train_df) vs names(predictors_reef).")
  }

  # Subset raster stack to ONLY predictors used (prevents NA-coverage truncation)
  pred_stack <- predictors_reef[[raster_needed]]

  # Add x/y rasters if model expects them
  if (need_xy) {
    x_r <- init(pred_stack[[1]], "x"); names(x_r) <- "x"
    y_r <- init(pred_stack[[1]], "y"); names(y_r) <- "y"
    pred_stack <- c(pred_stack, x_r, y_r)
  }

  # Prediction function called by terra::predict(model, v)
  pred_fun <- function(model, v) {
    v <- as.data.frame(v)
    names(v) <- names(pred_stack)

    # Inject required non-raster predictors
    if (need_year) v$Year <- as.numeric(year_value)
    if (need_fold) v$fold_id <- train_df$fold_id[1]

    # If model expects x/y but they were not in pred_stack for some reason:
    # (shouldn't happen, but safe)
    # if (need_xy && !all(c("x","y") %in% names(v))) stop("x/y missing in prediction stack")

    p <- predict(model, new_data = v, type = "prob")
    as.numeric(p$.pred_1)
  }

  # Run chunked prediction
  r_out <- terra::predict(
    pred_stack,
    fit_obj$fit,     # fitted tidymodels workflow
    fun   = pred_fun,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    cores = 1
  )

  names(r_out) <- layer_name
  r_out
}

# -------- build the 6 predictions ---------------------------------------

# Make sure these objects exist:
# fits_year, fits_agnostic  (each has entries like "thr_0.02" with $fit, $model_df)

preds <- list()

# Year models
preds[["year_thr0.00"]] <- predict_workflow_to_grid(
  fits_year[["thr_0"]] , predictors_reef, year_value = YEAR_TO_PREDICT, layer_name = "year_thr0.00"
)
preds[["year_thr0.02"]] <- predict_workflow_to_grid(
  fits_year[["thr_0.02"]], predictors_reef, year_value = YEAR_TO_PREDICT, layer_name = "year_thr0.02"
)
preds[["year_thr0.04"]] <- predict_workflow_to_grid(
  fits_year[["thr_0.04"]], predictors_reef, year_value = YEAR_TO_PREDICT, layer_name = "year_thr0.04"
)

# Agnostic models
preds[["agn_thr0.00"]] <- predict_workflow_to_grid(
  fits_agnostic[["thr_0"]] , predictors_reef, year_value = YEAR_TO_PREDICT, layer_name = "agn_thr0.00"
)
preds[["agn_thr0.02"]] <- predict_workflow_to_grid(
  fits_agnostic[["thr_0.02"]], predictors_reef, year_value = YEAR_TO_PREDICT, layer_name = "agn_thr0.02"
)
preds[["agn_thr0.04"]] <- predict_workflow_to_grid(
  fits_agnostic[["thr_0.04"]], predictors_reef, year_value = YEAR_TO_PREDICT, layer_name = "agn_thr0.04"
)

# Stack into one 6-layer SpatRaster
prob_6 <- stack_rasters(preds)
prob_6
names(prob_6)

# -------- write a single multi-band GeoTIFF ------------------------------
writeRaster(
  prob_6,
  filename  = out_tif,
  overwrite = TRUE,
  gdal      = c("COMPRESS=LZW", "TILED=YES", "BIGTIFF=YES")
)

message("Wrote 6-layer GeoTIFF: ", out_tif)
```

```{r Plot confusion nd metrics}
# -----------------------------------------------------------

    .pred_class  = factor(

  aug_cls,
  truth   = cots_problem,
  .pred_1               # probability of class "1" (problematic)
)$.estimate

  .pred_1
)$.estimate

# Threshold-based metrics (@ 0.5, since .pred_class already reflects that)

  truth   = cots_problem,
  estimate = .pred_class
)$.estimate

prec_val <- precision(
  aug_cls,
  truth   = cots_problem,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  event_level = "second"   # "1" is the second level
)$.estimate

recall_val <- recall(

  truth   = cots_problem,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  event_level = "second"
)$.estimate

  truth   = cots_problem,
  estimate = .pred_class,
  event_level = "second"
)$.estimate

  aug_cls,
  truth   = truth_num,
  estimate = .pred_1
)$.estimate

  aug_cls,
  truth   = truth_num,
  estimate = .pred_1
)$.estimate

# Helper: compute metrics at a given threshold ----------------------------
metrics_at_threshold <- function(data, thr) {
  data_thr <- data %>%
    mutate(
      .pred_class_thr = factor(
        if_else(.pred_1 >= thr, "1", "0"),
        levels = c("0", "1")
      )
    )

  tibble(
    threshold = thr,
    accuracy  = accuracy(data_thr, cots_problem, .pred_class_thr)$.estimate,
    precision = precision(data_thr, cots_problem, .pred_class_thr,
                          event_level = "second")$.estimate,
    recall    = recall(data_thr, cots_problem, .pred_class_thr,
                       event_level = "second")$.estimate,
    f1        = f_meas(data_thr, cots_problem, .pred_class_thr,
                       event_level = "second")$.estimate
  )
}

# Example: compare 0.5 vs 0.4 --------------------------------------------
thr_results <- bind_rows(
  metrics_at_threshold(aug_cls, 0.5),
  metrics_at_threshold(aug_cls, 0.4)
)

thr_results

thresholds <- seq(0.1, 0.9, by = 0.05)

thr_grid <- purrr::map_dfr(thresholds, ~metrics_at_threshold(aug_cls, .x))

ggplot(thr_grid, aes(threshold)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = precision, colour = "precision")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = recall,    colour = "recall")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = f1,        colour = "F1")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("precision" = "red",
                                 "recall"    = "blue",
                                 "F1"        = "black")) +
  labs(y = "Metric value", colour = "Metric",
       title = "Precision/Recall/F1 vs threshold")

```

```{r Model 2 COTS Density}
## 7. Model 2: XGBoost regression (COTS density) -------------------------

# 7.1 Optionally transform density (e.g. log to stabilise variance)
model_df <- model_df %>%
  mutate(
    cots_density_log = log1p(cots_density_cpue)  # log(1 + density)
  )

hist(model_df$cots_density_log)

# 7.2 CV folds: reuse same spatial folds for comparability
cv_folds_reg <- group_vfold_cv(model_df, group = fold_id, v = 5)

# 7.3 Recipe for regression
rec_reg <- recipe(cots_density_log ~ ., data = model_df %>% dplyr::select(-cots_density_cpue, -cots_problem)) %>%
  update_role(fold_id, new_role = "id") %>%
  step_rm(fold_id) %>%
  # step_rm(cots_density_cpue, cots_problem) %>%
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

# 7.4 XGBoost spec (regression)
xgb_spec_reg <- boost_tree(
  trees          = 1500,
  tree_depth     = tune(),
  learn_rate     = tune(),
  loss_reduction = tune(),
  min_n          = tune()
) %>%
  set_engine("xgboost") %>%
  set_mode("regression")

# 7.5 Workflow
wf_reg <- workflow() %>%
  add_model(xgb_spec_reg) %>%
  add_recipe(rec_reg)

# 7.6 Tuning grid (can re-use structure)
set.seed(123)
grid_reg <- grid_space_filling(
  tree_depth(),
  learn_rate(),
  loss_reduction(),
  min_n(),
  size = 10
)

res_reg <- tune_grid(
  wf_reg,
  resamples = cv_folds_reg,
  grid      = grid_reg,
  metrics   = metric_set(rmse, rsq)
)

# 7.7 Select best hyperparameters (minimising RMSE)
best_reg <- select_best(res_reg, metric = "rmse")

# 7.8 Finalise and fit
final_wf_reg <- finalize_workflow(wf_reg, best_reg)

set.seed(123)
fit_reg <- final_wf_reg %>%
  fit(data = model_df)

fit_reg

# 7.9 CV metrics for regression
collect_metrics(res_reg)

```

```{r}
############################################################
# Predict XGBoost classification to reef raster grid
# and plot in leaflet
############################################################

library(tidymodels)

# e.g. predict for 2025, or for the mean/most recent year in the data
target_year <- 2025
target_year <- max(model_df$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
# sanity check using your training data
range(model_df$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
library(terra)
library(tidymodels)

# predictors_reef: SpatRaster with all numeric predictors used in the model
#                  (no year layer, just env vars, outbreak metrics, etc.)
# fit_cls: fitted tidymodels workflow (classification model)

# 1) Define prediction function for terra::predict
# prediction function: x = matrix/data.frame of raster values
pred_fun.dens <- function(model, v) {
  # model: your fitted tidymodels workflow (fit_cls)
  # v    : matrix/data.frame of raster predictors for a chunk
  #        rows = cells, cols = layers in predictors_reef

  # Coerce to data.frame
  v <- as.data.frame(v)

  # Give columns the raster layer names (must match what the recipe expects)
  names(v) <- names(predictors_reef)

  # Add numeric Year column expected by the model
  v$Year <- target_year

   # Add dummy fold_id so hardhat is happy
  # Copy type from training data:
  v$fold_id <- model_df$fold_id[1]

  # Use the tidymodels workflow's predict()
  p <- predict(
    model,
    new_data = v,
    type     = "numeric"
  )

  # Return numeric vector of probabilities for the "1" class
  as.numeric(p$.pred)
}

# # Take a small sample of raster values
# test_mat <- terra::values(predictors_reef, mat = TRUE)[1:10, , drop = FALSE]
#
# # Run pred_fun on this sample
# test_pred <- pred_fun(test_mat)
# test_pred

names(model_df)         # make sure it's "Year" not "year"
str(model_df$Year)      # should be numeric (or integer)
str(model_df$fold_id)

# likely integer or factor
# 2) Run chunked prediction over the raster
prob_rast.dens <- terra::predict(
  predictors_reef,  # SpatRaster
  fit_reg,          # model argument
  fun   = pred_fun.dens,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  cores = 1         # keep 1 to avoid xgboost pointer weirdness
)

names(prob_rast.dens) <- "prob_problem"
prob_rast.dens
plot(prob_rast.dens)

# Optional: check CRS (ArcGIS can handle 7844 or 4326 just fine)
crs(prob_rast)

# 1) Write out as GeoTIFF in the raster's native CRS

# )
```
